locations.label: Speed Cola — eagle ramp · D2
locations.description: Drive a vehicle off the stone eagle ramp; collect the challenge reward if it is still available.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Jugger-Nog — campsite fire · C3
locations.description: Throw a Molotov into the campfire by Mister Peeks, then collect the reward.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Death Perception — rings · E1
locations.description: Parachute through all three sculpture rings in one flight. The pin marks the challenge area, not your flight path.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Deadshot — church opening · I3
locations.description: Throw a grenade through the high church opening shown in the guide photograph.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Tombstone — crane sightline · G7
locations.description: Use the crane sightline, aim a scoped weapon at distant Mister Peeks and hold your breath for the cue.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Stamin-Up — stairwell · D7
locations.description: Sprint from Mister Peeks at the bottom of the stairwell to the top.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Quick Revive — highway race · H5
locations.description: Start under the highway sign, wait for the laugh and race north to the next sign.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: PhD Flopper — manor pool · H7
locations.description: Dolphin-dive from the manor roof into the swimming pool.
locations.state: Independent challenge · may already be claimed

locations.label: Season 1 — Al Bagra portal · F6
locations.description: Island pedestal ritual near Bad Signal. Bring the four correct gold relics for a first unlock; use the proper Sigil side after permanent access.

locations.label: Season 2 — Nahr hill portal
locations.description: Search the hill/tower above Nahr Bathhouse around F4. Match the Drum, Mirror, Gloves and Target at the gold-relic pedestals; the guide has the full unlock.

locations.label: Season 3 — northwest island portal
locations.description: Search Tier 3’s northwest island circle around E3/E4. The Giraffe, Laptop, Drawing and Journal ritual is separate from ordinary triangle rewards. Use the island landmark to resolve the grid boundary.

locations.label: Season 5 — Opal Palace fountain
locations.description: Search the F5 Opal Palace fountain tornado. Use gold Mr. Peeks and the three gold Echo relics; the Ascension story portal is at the nearby northeast gazebo.

locations.label: Mirror upgrade — graveyard
locations.description: Offer the Mirror at the I3 graveyard pedestal and use the matching elemental mod on its marked zombie.

locations.label: Gloves upgrade — boxing gym
locations.description: At the F8 boxing gym, offer the Gloves, melee the bags left to right and finish the marked zombie.

locations.label: Target upgrade — firing range
locations.description: At H8’s firing range, offer the Target, shoot all eight targets and headshot the marked zombie.

locations.label: Echo Drum — four pillars
locations.description: Search the four-pillar square east of F7 Shorok Opera House. Use the pillar meteor and match the elemental zombies.

locations.label: Echo Giraffe — wrecked van
locations.description: Search the wrecked van in the square east of F4 Nahr Bathhouse. Use its meteor and finish the marked enemy chain.

locations.label: Echo Drum — Blood Burner course start
locations.description: Search the canal around F4/G4 by Mister Peeks. Follow the actual white arrows on the Blood Burner; this pin does not draw the riding route.

targets.title: Eight free-perk Easter eggs
targets.description: Independent challenges: choose the perk you need. Numbers identify the guide list, not a required order.

targets.title: Four seasonal Dark Aether portals
targets.description: Separate unlocks. Open the corresponding guide from the portal instructions; there is no required order between seasons.

targets.title: Red Worm — clue-photo walls
targets.description: Visit a clue wall and read its four photographs. These are alternative viewing sites, not four required USB stops.

targets.title: Red Worm — twelve USB candidates
targets.description: Use the four current clue photographs. The chart and map show candidates, not twelve required drives.

targets.title: Red Worm — possible arenas
targets.description: Only the current refractor site is the fight arena. The USB set does not determine which location is active.

targets.title: Chess vault — stationary transmitters
targets.description: These three transmitters have fixed references. Knight rides a moving truck; locate it in-game. All four transmissions are required, in any order.
